_meta.kind: paraphrased by hand, NOT downloaded, NOT verbatim
_meta.group_note: Higher numbers within the danger and great-danger groups show where the storm is expected to cross, not how intense it is.
_meta.advice_policy: No evacuation or safety advice is included. It is not part of the signal definitions.
_meta.review_required: Have BMD or a qualified Bangladeshi maritime authority confirm all wording before real users rely on it.

sea_ports.name: Distant Cautionary
sea_ports.summary: Squally weather (about 61 km/h) in the distant sea where a storm may form.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 1 (Distant Cautionary): squally weather far out at sea, a storm may form.

sea_ports.name: Distant Warning
sea_ports.note: Wording not confirmed against a source.
sea_ports.summary: A storm has formed in the distant sea.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 2 (Distant Warning): a storm has formed far out at sea.

sea_ports.name: Local Cautionary
sea_ports.summary: Port threatened by squally weather, wind 40-50 km/h.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 3 (Local Cautionary): port threatened by squalls, winds 40-50 km/h.

sea_ports.name: Local Warning
sea_ports.note: Wind speed not confirmed against a source.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 4 (Local Warning): port threatened by a storm.

sea_ports.name: Danger
sea_ports.summary: Slight or moderate storm (62-88 km/h) expected to cross the coast south of Chattogram or Cox's Bazar port and east of Mongla port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 5 (Danger): storm of 62-88 km/h expected to cross coast south of Chattogram/Cox's Bazar, east of Mongla.

sea_ports.name: Danger
sea_ports.summary: Slight or moderate storm (62-88 km/h) expected to cross the coast north of Chattogram or Cox's Bazar port and west of Mongla port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 6 (Danger): storm of 62-88 km/h expected to cross coast north of Chattogram/Cox's Bazar, west of Mongla.

sea_ports.name: Danger
sea_ports.note: Inferred from the south/north/over-or-near pattern; not confirmed for this number.
sea_ports.summary: Slight or moderate storm (62-88 km/h) expected over or near the port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 7 (Danger): storm of 62-88 km/h expected over or near the port.

sea_ports.name: Great Danger
sea_ports.summary: Great-intensity storm (89 km/h or more) expected to cross the coast south of Chattogram or Cox's Bazar port and east of Mongla port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 8 (Great Danger): storm of 89+ km/h expected to cross coast south of Chattogram/Cox's Bazar, east of Mongla.

sea_ports.name: Great Danger
sea_ports.note: Inferred from the group pattern; one source words this signal differently.
sea_ports.summary: Great-intensity storm (89 km/h or more) expected to cross the coast north of Chattogram or Cox's Bazar port and west of Mongla port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 9 (Great Danger): storm of 89+ km/h expected to cross coast north of Chattogram/Cox's Bazar, west of Mongla.

sea_ports.name: Great Danger
sea_ports.summary: Great-intensity storm (89 km/h or more) expected over or near the port.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 10 (Great Danger): storm of 89+ km/h expected over or near the port.

sea_ports.name: Failure of Communication
sea_ports.summary: Communication with the meteorological warning centre has broken down and the local officer considers there is danger of bad weather.
sea_ports.sms: BMD sea signal 11: contact with the storm warning centre is lost and the local officer sees danger of bad weather.

river_ports_note: Not loaded on purpose: the wording was not verified. Copy the 4 river signals from the BMD site and add them here.
